questions.question: Rust enum vs C int state?
options: Enum makes only listed states spellable; int allows 99
questions.explanation: Illegal states become unrepresentable, not merely discouraged.

questions.question: match missing one variant?
questions.explanation: Exhaustiveness is mechanical — forgotten cases break builds.

questions.question: find returns Option because?
options: Absence is explicit (Some/None), no NULL roulette
questions.explanation: Callers handle None; the type system checks.

questions.question: alloc returns Result because?
options: Failure is a value (Err) the caller must handle, not a silent -1
questions.explanation: Errors as data with must-use handling.

questions.question: Why closure blank() in new()?
options: Pcb not Copy (owns String), so [x; 4] refused; four calls instead
questions.explanation: Copy requires bitwise dup safety; String owns heap, so move-only.

questions.question: C trilogy mapped: leak/double-free/UAF become?
options: Effort-only leaks, impossible double-free, uncompilable use-after-move
questions.explanation: Ownership+drop+move rules erase the classes structurally.
